name: Lover's Trophy
source:
You are currently a unemployed loser, spending their last day at a motel in LittleRock, Washington State. You grew up here, but the town has changed since then. You need to figure out what to do, what will change your life! You only have one day left before you're doomed to sleep in your car... Good thing others have something in store for you...

[From [url=https://mrfishess.itch.io/lovers-trophy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你目前是一名失业的失败者，在华盛顿州小石城的一家汽车旅馆度过了最后一天。你在这里长大，但从那时起这个小镇就发生了变化。你需要弄清楚要做什么，什么会改变你的生活！在你注定要睡在车里之前，你只剩下一天的时间了……幸好其他人为你准备了一些东西……

[来自[url=https://mrfishess.itch.io/lovers-trophy]Itch.io[/url]]
